style: High-quality 3D animated feature film still, close to photoreal (modern big-studio animation look), rich detail, cinematic lighting and depth of field. Vertical 9:16, keep the top third fairly simple and dark-to-plain (text sits there), the action in the lower two thirds. The Sinai desert in ancient times, a huge camp of tents of the Children of Israel after crossing the sea. Any people are small, distant, seen from behind, ordinary people in simple earth-toned robes and head wraps.

scenes.s1: A vast parted sea with tall walls of water on both sides and a dry path of sand between, dawn light breaking through, birds, awe-inspiring, no people visible.
scenes.s2: A great rocky mountain in the Sinai desert at night under a clear starry sky, no glow, no light on the summit, a tiny camp of tents far below with small campfires. No people visible.
scenes.s3: A huge desert camp of tents at sunset, smoke from cooking fires, crowds small and seen from behind gathering toward the centre.
scenes.s4: A shining calf statue made of melted ornaments standing on a rough stone pedestal in the middle of a desert camp, gold glinting, dust in the air, an eerie atmosphere. Crowd only as tiny silhouettes far behind.
scenes.s5: A crowd of ordinary people seen from far behind, bowing on the ground toward a distant gleaming calf statue in a desert camp at dusk, torches burning, ominous.
scenes.s6: Close-up of an ordinary man's hand (no face) letting a handful of desert dust fall through the air at dusk, plain natural light, no beams, no glow, blurred tents behind.
scenes.s7: The calf statue melting and burning in a great fire in the desert at night, flames and sparks, no people near it.
scenes.s8: Ash and dust blown by a strong wind over a dark sea at dawn, waves, dramatic sky. No people.
scenes.s9: A calm desert at sunrise after a storm, clear golden light over the camp of tents, peaceful, birds in the sky.
